capabilities.description: Find files and directories by name under a remote directory over the session file backend.

pattern.description: Glob matched against each entry's name (not its path): * any run of characters, ? one character, [abc] / [a-z] / [!abc] a character set. Case-sensitive and matches the whole name, so use *nginx* for "contains".

type.description: Only return entries of this type: file, directory, or symlink. Default: any.

maxDepth.description: Directory levels to search below path. 1 searches only path itself (no recursion); default 5, at most 20. Symlinked directories are not followed.

maxResults.description: Stop after this many matches; default 200, at most 1000.

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading at; default 0. Continue a truncated read with the returned nextOffset.

maxBytes.description: Most bytes to return in this call; default 262144 (256 KiB), at most 8388608. The result reports totalBytes, truncated and nextOffset.

modelDescriptionHints.sftp.find: Use this instead of walking directories with sftp_list or running find through terminal_execute. The search is bounded: when truncated is true, narrow path or pattern, or lower maxDepth, rather than repeating the same call. Directories that cannot be read are skipped and counted in unreadableDirectories.
modelDescriptionHints.sftp.read: Returns text. A large file comes back in pieces: when truncated is true, call again with offset set to nextOffset, or use sftp_stat first to see the size. For a log, read the tail by setting offset near totalBytes.
